Molecular analysis showed a heterozygous mutation, which led to a tyrosine to cysteine change at amino acid position 95, compatible with a type II HBS defect (). At the start of her pregnancy, thromboprophylaxis with self-injection of LMWH at 4100 units every 12 hours with FFP 1 unit weekly was prescribed to replace warfarin because of its adverse effects on the fetus. The patient and her newborn were discharged without morbidity 7 days later. She continued the same doses of LMWH with FFP, which was replaced with oral anticoagulant therapy from 6 weeks after delivery.
